chunks: I wrote to Abu Ja'far (the second Imam), peace be upon him: 'The narrations regarding completing (al-itmam) and shortening (al-taqir) the prayer in the two Sanctuaries differ regarding your forefathers, peace be upon them. Some say to complete the prayer, even if it is just one prayer, and some say to shorten the prayer unless one intends to stay for ten days. I continued to complete the prayer in both until we departed from our Hajj this year, for the jurists of our companions advised me to shorten it if I did not intend to stay for ten days. I became constrained by this until I could know your opinion. He wrote in his own hand, peace be upon him: "You know the virtue of the prayer in the two Sanctuaries over others, so I love for you, when you enter them, not to shorten and to multiply the prayer in them." I said to him two years later in person: "I wrote to you such and such, and you answered such and such." He said: "Yes." I said: "What do you mean by the two Sanctuaries?" He said: "Mecca and Medina. And when? When you head from Mina, shorten the prayer. But when you return from Arafat to Mina, visit the House, and return to Mina, then complete the prayer for those three days." And he indicated with his finger three times.'

And that which indicates that completing the prayer in these two places has come as a preferred act (mustahabb), and that if a person does not complete it in them, they are not blameworthy, is added to this report and to what preceded it, what has been narrated:

key_terms.اَلتَّقْصِير: Shortening the prayer (praying two rak'ahs instead of four)
key_terms.اَلْإِتْمَام: Completing the prayer (praying four rak'ahs instead of two)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on shortening or completing prayer in Mecca and Medina according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This correspondence highlights the Shia juristic preference (istihbab) for completing the four-rak'ah prayer in Mecca and Medina, distinguishing it from the obligatory shortening practiced elsewhere. Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that while shortening is valid, completing the prayer is superior, particularly after returning from Arafat to visit the Kaaba before resuming shortening in Mina. This ruling underscores the spiritual merit of the Sanctuaries, encouraging pilgrims to maximize worship in these holy sites.
